description: Na₂V₃P₂O₁₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pccn space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.98 Å. There are two inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.65-2.54 Å. In the second V site, V is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted VO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.64-2.00 Å. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent VO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.56 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one V atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two V atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent V atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one V, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one V, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na, one V, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one V, and one P atom.
